title: NASA's Next Space Chip Is Being Torture-Tested
description: NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory is testing a radiation-hardened processor built with Microchip Technology. The goal is up to one hundred times the computing power of today's spaceflight computers; early indications suggest about five hundred times. It is not yet certified for flight.

beats.vo: Spacecraft run on computers far slower than your phone.

beats.text: A faster brain, built for radiation
points: Goal: up to one hundred times faster

caption:
Spacecraft run on computers slower than your phone. 🛰️
NASA's JPL is testing a radiation-hardened chip (with Microchip Technology) aiming for up to 100x today's spaceflight computing; early indications show ~500x vs current rad-hard chips. Still in testing, not flight-certified.
Why care: radio delay means spacecraft must think for themselves.
